entries.description: Hosted MCP server giving agents Exa web search and clean page fetching. Works without an API key at limited usage; connect with an Exa API key or OAuth for full limits and the Exa research agent tool.
representativeQueries: search the web for current information about a topic
fetch and read the content of a web page as markdown
find recent news, papers, or companies matching a description
run a multi-step research task and return a cited report

entries.description: REST API for neural and keyword web search, page contents extraction, similarity search, grounded answers, the Exa research agent, monitors, batch jobs, and structured data collection (Websets).
representativeQueries: search the web with semantic or keyword queries and get ranked results
retrieve clean text, highlights, or summaries from a list of URLs
find pages similar to a given URL
get a cited answer to a factual question from the live web

entries.description: Agent skill (SKILL.md) that teaches coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor and Codex how to search, retrieve content, run research, and build applications with Exa. Per-task skills live in the repository.
representativeQueries: teach my coding agent how to use the Exa API
install a skill for web research in Claude Code or Cursor
give my agent a lead-generation or company-research workflow
